name: Toumine Tsukasa
source:
Likes: Fortune goods, [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maneki-neko]manekineko[/url], baths
Dislikes: Diseases, painful things
Favorite food: Fried [url=http://www.japantimes.co.jp/life/2013/09/26/food/japans-secret-love-of-a-breakfast-loaf/#.VVRxl_mqqko]shokupan[/url]
Disliked food: Smoked food

A cheerful girl who works hard to make money for a reason she refuses to explain. She has a habit of apologizing for the least of things, and her gratitude when given something (such as food) is far out of proportion with what the gift is actually worth. Oddly, despite her need for money, she refuses to borrow money from [url=/c1792]Yuuma[/url] or anyone else, saying that "there is no meaning if I don't earn it on my own".

[Edited from [url=http://clephasstomach.blogspot.com/2011/08/review-irotoridori-no-sekai.html?zx=61035860c761e3b7]Clephas' review[/url]]
